Credits

Maze Tower Defense
A grid-based maze-building tower defense game, styled after a Windows 95 shareware CD.

Built by Carson Watts, with Claude Code.

Confirm Prestige

Prestiging ends this run immediately and starts a brand new one. Your gold, towers, and wave progress this run will NOT carry over — but you'll permanently earn +1 Prestige Point to spend in the Prestige Tree (Main Menu), forever. Are you sure?

Confirm Reset

This will permanently erase all unlocks and themes for this browser. This cannot be undone. Are you sure?

Return to Main Menu?

Are you sure? Your current run keeps going in the background — you can pick it back up from the Main Menu's Play button.
